_rule: Degree gate: a student's degree passes a record if its degree field is in the record's primary_fields, OR if the degree field 'counts_as' one of them. aliases = Indian degree titles that ARE that field (used to set the student's degree_field). Anything not listed = no automatic match: the committee decides, shown as a note only. Record-level exceptions (e.g. 10623 EE degrees only) live in engine_config.json 'exclusions' and win.

aliases: B.Tech Computer Science and Information Technology (CSIT)

cse_specialisations.decision: Approved 26.10.2026: CSE specialisations and AI&DS count as computer_science

electronics_communication.decision: Approved 26.10.2026: ECE / EIE count as electrical_electronic_engineering, except records hard-coded otherwise

mechanical_related.decision: Approved 26.10.2026: no automatic match (regulations call these 'related' and the committee decides) -> shown with a note
